item.coloph: de ltar rmi lam bag chags 'khrul snang 'di/ mtshan ldan bla ma'i gsung gis rab bskul nas/ dkar chag yi ge ris su bris pa 'di/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams la mthol lo bshags/ bka' skyong srung ma rnams la bzod par gsol/ dge ba'i 'gro kun sdug bsngal nad sel shog sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis rnal 'byor mi shig rdo rjer o rgyan gling pa la brgyud pa dge legs 'phel//
